### GT table

```{r gt-table, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}


weekly_margins <- readr::read_csv("weekly_margins.csv")

weekly_margin_gt <- weekly_margins |>
  dplyr::filter(average_margin > 20.9) |> 
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = average_margin, decimals = 1) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    season = "Season",
    week = "Week",
    games = "FBS Games",
    average_margin = "Avg Margin"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(season, week, games, average_margin)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(
    title = "Widest Average Margin of Victory by Week",
    subtitle = "Completed regular-season weeks with at least 10 FBS-vs-FBS games since 2014."
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data from collegefootballdata.com | Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = average_margin, rows = 1)
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(
    table.width = gt::px(650)
  ) 



gt_save_crop(
  weekly_margin_gt,
  file = "week_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
) 


weekly_margin_gt
```

### Geom tile time possession

```{r geom-tile, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE}

game_date <- "2026-09-05"
home_team <- "Michigan"
away_team <- "Western Michigan"
home_score <- 13L
away_score <- 12L

# Per-minute possession table, pre-computed from collegefootballdata.com drive
# and play-by-play data (columns: minute, quarter, minute_in_quarter,
# possessing_team). Loaded here instead of hitting the CFBD API.


team_colors <- c(
  Michigan = "#FFCB05",
  `Western Michigan` = "#532E1F",
  `No possession` = "#DAD8CE" # flexoki base150
)


minute_possession <- readr::read_csv("michigan_western_michigan_top_tile_2026-09-05.csv")

# One chart, one row per quarter. Each tile is a game minute, filled with the
# color of whichever team held the ball longest that minute.
quarter_tiles <- minute_possession |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    possessing_team = dplyr::coalesce(possessing_team, "No possession"),
    quarter_label = factor(
      paste0("Q", quarter),
      levels = c("Q4", "Q3", "Q2", "Q1")
    ),
    possessing_team = factor(
      possessing_team,
      levels = c(home_team, away_team, "No possession")
    )
  )

plot_title <- sprintf(
  "%s %d, %s %d",
  home_team, home_score, away_team, away_score
)


top_tile_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  quarter_tiles,
  ggplot2::aes(x = minute_in_quarter, y = quarter_label, fill = possessing_team)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "#FFFCF0", linewidth = 0.6, height = 0.74) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = team_colors,
    breaks = c(home_team, away_team), # "No possession" kept in palette, hidden from legend
    name = NULL,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 15),
    labels = c("1", "5", "10", "15"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.55)) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = plot_title,
    subtitle = "Each tile is one game minute, split by quarter and colored by the team.<br>Western Michigan controlled possession **40:08 to 19:52** (if only is was 40:09 to 19:51).", 
    x = "Minute of quarter",
    y = NULL,
    caption = 
      "Possession windows derived from collegefootballdata.com drive and play-by-play data | Viz by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  ) +
  flexoki::theme_flexoki_light(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 2, 0),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 9.5, lineheight = 1.4),
    plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 8, hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(16, 22, 16, 16)
  )


ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "mich-plot.png",
  plot = top_tile_plot,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 4.6,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "#FFFCF0"
)


top_tile_plot
```
